_comment: Curated recurring SG kids language programmes — real organisers and registration pages. The Community Scout agent rolls these forward to concrete upcoming dates and (with an LLM) writes warm parent-facing descriptions.

events.title: Tamil Storytime for Little Ones
events.description: Librarians bring Tamil picture books alive with songs and actions. Drop in with your child and enjoy stories read aloud in Tamil.

events.title: Chinese Storytime 华语讲故事
events.description: Weekly Mandarin storytelling session with picture books, rhymes and simple crafts for preschoolers.

events.title: Malay Storytime — Mari Dengar Cerita!
events.description: Stories, songs and rhymes in Malay for young children and their families.

events.title: SINDA Family Reading Club (Tamil)
events.description: Guided Tamil reading and word games for children with a parent — build a home reading habit together.

events.title: CDAC Little Readers Workshop 小小读书会
events.description: Interactive Chinese reading circle with games and craft — children practise speaking Mandarin in a fun small group.

events.title: MENDAKI Cerita Club
events.description: Storytelling and language play in Malay — children explore words through drama and song with trained facilitators.

events.title: Indian Heritage Centre Family Day
events.description: Culture and craft morning — kids discover Tamil heritage through hands-on activities and gallery trails.

events.title: SCCC Kids' Cultural Playdate 文化同乐会
events.description: Mandarin-friendly cultural workshops — calligraphy, opera masks and festival crafts for young families.
events.venue: Singapore Chinese Cultural Centre, 1 Straits Boulevard

events.title: Malay Heritage Craft Corner
events.description: Family craft session inspired by Malay traditions — children learn everyday Malay words while they make and play.

events.title: Esplanade PLAYtime! Family Theatre
events.description: Theatre made for the very young — multilingual shows where children join in the storytelling.

events.title: Community Club Mother Tongue Playgroup
events.description: Neighbourhood playgroup sessions in Tamil, Mandarin and Malay — check your nearest community club for the language offered.
